title: SignalRecord
description: The canonical signal record written by Python Lambda and read by TypeScript Lambda

analysis_id.description: Unique identifier for this analysis run (UUID v4)

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA, AAPL

analysis_date.description: The trading date this analysis targets, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD)

depth.description: Analysis depth: shallow uses fewer analysts, medium uses the full set

status.description: Lifecycle state of the signal record

delivery_type.description: Whether the analysis was triggered by the scheduled cron or by a Discord command

signal.description: The trading signal produced by the analysis

action.description: Human-readable action recommendation, e.g. 'Enter long position'

time_horizon.description: Human-readable time horizon from TradingAgents, e.g. '2 weeks'

time_window.description: Normalized time window category derived from time_horizon

summary.description: Human-readable narrative summary of the analysis

executive_summary.description: One-paragraph executive summary of the signal

investment_thesis.description: Core reasoning for the signal rating

key_risk.description: Primary risk factor that could invalidate the thesis

analysts_used.description: List of TradingAgents analyst names that contributed to this signal

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the analysis completed

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was first created in DynamoDB
